'''Gil''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Prince/Legends|prince]] from a [[Technology-deficient planet|technologically-inept]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. He was the son of a [[King/Legends|king]] who ruled the side of the planet closest to the night, and the boyfriend of Princess [[Risa]].
